snippet.title: One Piece World Seeker – PS4/XB1/PC – Welcome to Prison Island (Introduction Cinematic)
snippet.description:
When a rumor about a huge treasure spread, the Straw Hat Crew is never far away…But when this turns out to be a deception to cover a shady conspiracy, it develops into a thrilling adventure!
Watch the introduction of ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER and the first clash of ambitions between Luffy and Issac, the warden of Prison Island!

Pre-order it on http://bnent.eu/preorderONEPIECEWORLDSEEKER
Fans that preorder the game will be granted exclusive access to an extra mission as well as the Swimsuit and Military Costume.

ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER will be available on March 15th, 2019 for PlayStation®4, Xbox One and PC.

Continue the adventure on:
ONE PIECE Games Official Website: www.OnePiece-Game.com  
Official Facebook Page: http://www.facebook.com/onepiece.videogames
Official Twitter Account: https://twitter.com/onepiece_games

#onepieceworldseeker #onepiece #bandainamco
